Brother arrested for Shimla school director's murder over financial dispute

Police in Shimla have arrested a man for allegedly plotting the murder of his brother, a school executive. The motive is reported to be a financial dispute involving approximately Rs 8 crore. The arrest was made along with an accomplice.
